'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Diehl DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Diehl]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' ISBLEH
* '''Username:''' Scottd
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
